submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"

finding.headline: "The Mama's Lap-Tray (UMBRELLA / FLAGSHIP)"
finding.problem: "Everyone asks 'is the baby fed?' Nobody asks 'is MAMA fed?' I sit there nursing for 45 minutes and my own food is across the room, cold, and I can't reach it."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A breastfeeding African/diaspora mum, baby latched or bottle in one arm, who needs a complete system — one-handed meal + snack + water within arm's reach — so she is nourished in the exact moment the baby is.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Flagship standalone / Bundle of bundles — "The Mama's Feeding Tray: Feed Yourself While You Feed Your Baby" (one-handed recipes + snack-station setup + hydration + lap-tray checklist). This is the deepest-dive niche (Stages 3–6).". Verdict: PASSES (20/25)..
